title: Manali Tour Package
overview: Discover the beauty of the Himalayas with SafarTrails’ best Manali tour packages, designed for unforgettable holidays filled with adventure, nature, and relaxation. Explore Manali’s stunning landscapes, snow-capped mountains, peaceful valleys, and charming local attractions. Our Manali tour packages are perfect for couples, families, friends, and solo travelers looking for a memorable getaway. From sightseeing at Solang Valley and Rohtang Pass to exploring Hadimba Temple and enjoying the vibrant atmosphere of Mall Road, experience the best of Manali with ease. Choose SafarTrails for comfortable stays, convenient travel arrangements, customizable itineraries, and memorable experiences at competitive prices.

itinerary.title: Delhi / Chandigarh to Manali | Scenic Drive & Mall Road
itinerary.description: Pickup from Delhi / Chandigarh by private cab. Enjoy a scenic journey through the Himalayan foothills along the Beas River to Manali. On arrival, check in to your hotel and unwind. In the evening, visit Mall Road and the Tibetan Monastery. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing | Hadimba, Manu Temple & Old Manali
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, visit the famous wooden Hadimba Devi Temple surrounded by cedar forests, Manu Temple in Old Manali, and Vashisht Village with its natural hot sulphur springs. Spend the afternoon exploring Van Vihar nature park along the Beas River and enjoy the evening in Old Manali cafés and Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Sissu via Atal Tunnel
itinerary.description: Breakfast at the hotel. Drive to Solang Valley for panoramic Himalayan mountain views and outdoor activities. Proceed through the Atal Tunnel under the Rohtang Pass into the dramatic landscapes of Lahaul Valley to visit Sissu and its alpine waterfall. Return to Manali by evening. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali to Delhi / Chandigarh via Kullu Valley | Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and complete hotel check-out. Drive towards Delhi / Chandigarh via Kullu Valley, with optional stops for river rafting, paragliding at Dobhi, and local shopping at Kullu shawl factories. Continue the return drive. Tour Ends with wonderful Himalayan memories.

faqs.question: Why choose a Manali tour package with Safar Trails?
faqs.answer: Traveling independently requires coordinating mountain cabs, hotel bookings, and sightseeing permits separately. Safar Trails combines verified 3★/4★ accommodation, dedicated private transport from Delhi/Chandigarh, curated sightseeing (Solang, Atal Tunnel, Sissu, Hadimba), and 24x7 concierge support into one transparent, hassle-free plan.

faqs.question: What is the best time to plan a Manali trip?
faqs.answer: Summer (March to June) is ideal for pleasant weather, green valleys, and comfortable sightseeing. Winter (October to February) attracts travelers seeking snowfall, snow sports in Solang, and winter wonderland landscapes. Monsoon (July to September) brings lush greenery, though travelers should check weather conditions.

faqs.question: Manali tour package from Delhi — what does it include?
faqs.answer: It includes pickup and drop from Delhi or Chandigarh by private AC cab with an experienced mountain driver, all fuel, toll and parking charges, 3 nights hotel accommodation in Manali with daily breakfast and dinner, and full local sightseeing including Solang Valley and Atal Tunnel to Sissu.

faqs.answer: Yes. Staying in one hotel for all three nights eliminates the stress of packing and moving mid-trip. Sightseeing is spaced comfortably across two days, and vehicles remain at your disposal throughout.

faqs.answer: Yes. Couples can request special honeymoon inclusions like floral bed decorations, candlelight dinners, cake, and room upgrades to mountain-facing or balcony view rooms.
